one_liner: Two MA103 labs: logistic regression predicting Ranger School outcomes (synthetic data) and a gamified Streamlit curve-fitting challenge.
problem: First-year cadets need intuition for model families, parameters, fit metrics and classification.
approach: sklearn scaled logistic regression with confusion matrix and odds ratios, where students score their own 'SIM' soldiers; seeded exponential/power/sinusoidal data where students tune sliders until NRMSE < 0.1.
decision_relevance: Military-relevant classification framing (selection outcomes) and quantitative model-fit judgment.

headline_results.evidence: Computed coef*SD (should be coef/SD) and printed under the ruck-time label
1,000-seed simulation: the true generating model reaches NRMSE<0.1 on only 64% of power and 78% of trig problems

limitations: MSE reported as classifier metric; |coef| 'importance' with collinear raw/points pairs
